tilly.label: Tilly has a note.
lines: Tilly is a tortilla press. She has been pressed into service since the first day.
On thickness, she has the final word. On everything else, she is flat on the matter.

lester.label: A word from Lester, unprompted.
lines: Lester remembers every taco he has ever served. He remembers very few customers' names.
He asked us to say the taco you almost ordered was a good choice.

marisol.label: Marisol, by the order pad.
lines: Marisol keeps Friday's receipts on Friday. Her pen is not for sketching tacos.
She goes home at five. The salsa has been warned.
